response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share)

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories that have at least one telescope in the telescopes table are counted as observatories (observatories with zero telescopes are excluded from the average share).
The average share is the unweighted mean of per-observatory shares across all observatories that appear in telescopes.
